message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras to suit your taste!

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for 9×13 in. pan) |
|----------|------------|-----------------------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Dry lasagna noodles (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (≈ 450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp (optional) |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (optional)** | Butter | 2 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 2 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 2 cups (480 ml) |
| | Nutmeg (grated) | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup (50 g) |

### Quick Assembly Steps
1. **Cook the noodles** (if using regular ones) until al dente, then drain and lay flat on a sheet of parchment or lightly oiled tray.  
2. **Prepare the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, seasonings, and simmer 20–30 min.  
3. **Mix ricotta filling**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.  
4. **Optional bechamel**: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk, cook until thickened, season.  
5. **Layer**: start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta mixture, sauce, and a sprinkle of mozzarella. Repeat until all layers are used, finishing with mozzarella and Parmesan on top.  
6. **Bake**: cover with foil (to prevent sticking, tent it slightly), bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.  
7. **Rest**: let stand 10–15 min before slicing.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
